answer: Identity Atlas enforces a progressive contribution requirement where each new identity must periodically provide unique value measured in a standardized unit. The trellis system tracks contribution diversity across participants, making it economically prohibitive to deploy sybil identities since each must maintain distinct, verifiable outputs. Attackers face an escalating cost curve as the haven mechanism penalizes duplicate or low-value contributions, forcing them to generate genuine, differentiated content or pay an ever-increasing fee measured in network resources.
